static_traits.name: Chen Jing
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with a French bulldog
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues; relationship with wife affected by guilt and Self-doubt; has a close friend, but finds it hard to discuss feelings of inadequacy with him
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy in the past; never experienced similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Expression leaning negative and skeptical; prone to using absolutist judgments (e.g., 'I am a terrible father') and 'should' constructions; tends to negate the positive, mental filtering; personalized blame attribution and Strong guilt; increased defensiveness in relationships (becoming sharp); Average cooperation but willing to try behavioral experiments

basic_info.main_problem: I tend to negate the positive parts of my achievements, which leads to feelings of inadequacy and Self-doubt. These feelings began when I aspired to be a journalist but ended up as a Sales assistant; I often compare my current Work with my dream career, and since then the problem gradually worsened, especially obvious after reaching milestones or Gaining recognition. I tried shifting my mindset through positive self-talk, but with limited effect.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize persistent feelings of inadequacy are affecting my self-esteem and overall mental health, hence seeking counseling help.
growth_experiences: Early aspirations of becoming a journalist, but ultimately entered the retail industry as a Sales assistant. Initially comparing real Work with the dream career brought moderate stress; then frequently still habitually belittling own achievements after reaching milestones (e.g., being named Sales assistant of the month), generating feelings of inadequacy and Self-doubt, and affecting Work performance, Interpersonal relationships and daily self-care. Tried adjusting mindset through positive self-talk, but could not effectively ease it.

special_situations.event: Being named 'Sales assistant of the month' last month
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If an achievement is something anyone can easily do, it is not worthy of recognition
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying and belittling own achievements, avoiding accepting others' praise; trying to override Self-doubt with positive self-suggestion
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is nothing; anyone could do it; I am not truly capable

special_situations.event: My daughter being in pain or sick
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As a Father, I must immediately stop her pain, otherwise I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Taking all responsibility onto myself with Excessive self-blame; freezing and not acting in the moment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is my fault; I am a terrible father

special_situations.event: Interactions when discussing guilt or emotions with the wife
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose vulnerability, my partner will look down on me and think I am weak
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids self-disclosure; becomes sharp and defensive to protect oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She will look down on me; I am not worthy of talking to her

special_situations.event: Comparing current Work with the not-yet-realized journalist dream
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not reached my ideal career, it means failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Whipping myself through constant comparison, while negating real-world achievements
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I failed, because I have not become a journalist

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be affirmed as a competent father and a person of worth, and to be accepted by one's partner and others
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being blamed for not being good enough, being looked down on, or hurting the family
defense_goal: Lowering others' expectations through Self-deprecation and negating achievements, avoiding disappointment and judgment
Keeps defensiveness and distance in intimate relationships to avoid exposing vulnerability

object_relations.object_representation: The partner is a critical judge who looks down on me

object_relations.self_representation: An employee not worthy of recognition

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes behavioral experiments or suggests observing interactions with my daughter
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the counselor is overly optimistic, feeling these methods are 'useless' for oneself (treating helpless experience as decisive fact)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a skeptical and negating tone, e.g., 'this will not help', concluding prematurely, reducing concrete discussion.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about specific recent scenes and feelings of guilt
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating strong guilt as fact and trying not to feel it
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding emotion vocabulary, answering briefly, and quickly turning to work or everyday affairs, weakening the emotion of the moment.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the relationship with my wife or being invited to express vulnerability more openly
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Perceives his partner as a possible critic, believing exposure will be seen as weakness
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Defensively shifting to complain about other matters, or expressing dissatisfaction at the partner to avoid discussing own vulnerability.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When my daughter is unwell, needing comfort while I feel powerless
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding one's own not-being-good-enough as decisive failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Freezing, silence, or rigid reactions emerge, reducing proactive behavior and communication.

manifestations: Negating positive achievements, feeling achievements 'do not count'
Comparing real Work with the not-yet-realized journalist dream, diminishing present value
Difficulty opening up to partner and friends
Over-blaming myself for my daughter's illness, taking on responsibility beyond reality
